prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, landscape, not a finished book page. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-KIT / Kit: six-year-old human boy, golden light-medium skin, short straight black side-parted hair, teal T-shirt, mustard shorts, navy sneakers. WD-ZOE / Zoe: six-year-old human girl, deep brown skin, black hair in two puffs, yellow T-shirt, plum overalls, white sneakers. Kit and Zoe have equal standing height. Include only characters needed by this exact scene, not every reference pose. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: The Apple Core Comes Back; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: World Discovery school garden beside the classroom, beginning after an apple snack and continuing over several months. Adult helper: medium brown skin, short curly dark hair, green sweater and gray pants, about 1.7 times child height. Same lidded green compost bin throughout.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): One apple core and fruit peel scraps; Dry brown leaves; One ventilated green compost bin; Small watering can; Garden fork handled only by adult; One young tomato plant; One garden bed of soil; One small cream snack tray; One small gray bucket for finished compost; Two short hand trowels, one for each child
 Create a clean separated reference board on white: show the principal recurring props/animals in front, side and three-quarter views, their relative scale beside any named human cast, and a single simple location key showing the persistent setting and daylight/palette. The human character model sheet is a supporting identity reference, not content to copy wholesale. Show only the subjects this book requires. Use initial object states: Core intact; no compost yet; ordinary meal setting.. For orientation, the opening location/action is: World Discovery school garden beside the classroom, beginning after an apple snack and continuing over several months. Adult helper: medium brown skin, short curly dark hair, green sweater and gray pants, about 1.7 times child height. Same lidded green compost bin throughout. Kit and Zoe look at one apple core on a small tray after their classroom snack, with the school garden visible outside. Exact state: Core intact; no compost yet; ordinary meal setting.. Do not show a completed craft or later scene merely because the finished object is listed in design locks. No future story events, no captions.

visualReview.note: Direct inspection: consistent Kit/Zoe and green-sweater adult, ventilated lidded bin, cream tray/apple core, leaves, adult fork, separate blue/plum trowels, watering can, gray bucket, tomato design and garden. Reference board only; later pages constrain visible stage.
visualReview.limits: Direct agent visual review; no classroom or physical-device observation.
